items.title: Sign and return the usage contract
items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benoetigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurueck.
items.computation: Private cooperative contract, so no statutory authority delivery-fiction rule applies; the period runs ab dem Briefdatum (18.11.2026, a Wednesday). Treating the letter date as the starting event and not counting that day (section 187 BGB), counting starts 19.11.2026. Werktage are Monday to Saturday, excluding Sunday and public holidays, as the letter itself states. Counting 14 Werktage: 19.11 Thu(1), 20.11 Fri(2), 21.11 Sat(3), 22.11 Sun skipped, 23.11 Mon(4), 24.11 Tue(5), 25.11 Wed(6), 26.11 Thu(7), 27.11 Fri(8), 28.11 Sat(9), 29.11 Sun skipped, 30.11 Mon(10), 01.12 Tue(11), 02.12 Wed(12), 03.12 Thu(13), 04.12 Fri(14). No NW public holidays occur in this window. The 14th Werktag falls on a Friday, so no further adjustment is needed. Final day: 2026-12-04.

items.quote: der Vorstand hat Ihnen die Wohnung Siedlungsweg 18 zum 01.01.2027 zugeteilt.
